entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: You? What're you doing in my house?

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Oh... G-Good... evening, sir... We...[n]didn't mean... to intrude...

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: Friends nowadays get that close to[n]each other?

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: That's not it! This, um...[n]Things happened... and...

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Um, we brought you some sushi, but[n]nobody answered when we rang the[n]bell... The door was unlocked too.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: We could hear the TV though, so we got[n]worried you might have passed out[n]or something...

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: ...I do that sometimes. Guess I'm getting[n]old.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Um, excuse me. There's something we'd[n]like to ask.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: There's someone else living here...[n]isn't there?

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: U-Um... is there any way we could meet with[n]Futaba-san?

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: I think we may have frightened her[n]earlier, so we'd like to apologize if[n]at all possible...

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: I don't want you all getting the wrong[n]idea...

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: I shouldn't have kept this a secret[n]from you.

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: Let's talk at my shop. She'll hear us if[n]we stay here.
